subject.title: feat: browsable merch starter on Commerce and Inventory

question: Should this reusable starter expansion merge after confirming the EmDash upgrade path for existing initialized instances?
rationale: The branch changes the seeded content contract and public routes; the supplied proof is strong for a fresh local setup but does not establish upgrade behavior for prior starter data.

options.title: Confirm upgrade behavior, then merge
options.body: Verify an existing initialized starter preserves its prior content and can load the new merchandise collection before approving the new default.

options.title: Defer until upgrade guidance exists
options.body: Keep the catalog branch open until maintainers define or document the supported migration behavior for existing starter instances.

recommendation.title: Confirm upgrade behavior, then merge
recommendation.body: Verify an existing initialized starter preserves its prior content and can load the new merchandise collection before approving the new default.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged and proposed work spans the price, availability, seed, and catalog surfaces involved in the upgrade decision.
